thread:
Aisha Ramos: Quick heads-up — external pen-test vendor asked to expand scope to include service-account tokens + KMS-wrapped secrets. Can we lock scope by EOD? We need a stable snapshot for evidence packaging.
Tom Li: Agree, scope freeze is important. If we allow tokens we need an inventory of service accounts + owners. I can pull a list from IAM this afternoon. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Priya Nair: We also need to confirm audit logging for token use is on for all projects. Last time sampling was off for staging. I’ll check logging config and retention.
Nikita Patel: If KMS is in scope, we should validate key ACLs and whether key wrapping was used for snapshots. Also need to decide if we provide read-only KMS proxy or temporary HSM creds.
Aisha Ramos: For retest planning — vendor asked for two 3-hour windows next week. Can ops/release hold the morning slot? We want on-call and the SRE observer available.
Tom Li: Morning slot OK — I’ll reserve 9–12 Wed. Can someone add it to the remediation tracker? Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/secure/pt/board/123 (placeholder)
Nikita Patel: Added preliminary owner tags to tracker. Also flagging these action items: inventory, log proof exports, KMS ACL snapshot.
Priya Nair: Quick config snippet we should standardize for audit-forwarding (add to checklist):
```
# prometheus -> loki forwarding (example)
scrape_configs:
  - job_name: 'k8s-pods'
    pipeline_stages:
      - docker: {}
    relabel_configs:
      - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_namespace]
        target_label: namespace
```
Make sure token-use events are captured in audit logs.
Aisha Ramos: For RBAC changes: we’ll create a temporary 'pt-assessor' role with narrow permissions. Priya — can you propose exact privileges?
Priya Nair: Proposed minimal role (short): `kms:Decrypt`, `kms:DescribeKey`, `iam:ListServiceAccounts`, `logging:ListLogs`. Will send full JSON policy in the tracker.
Tom Li: Ops note — limit exposure window to 4 hours and rotate any temp creds immediately after. Add a pre-retest checklist: evidence upload, signed attestations from owners.
Jules (sec-bot): Reminder: create audit export before any role changes. Automated check scheduled at 6876543600.
Nikita Patel: One more: vendor requested sanitized sample logs to validate detection rules. We should provide a sample dataset with PII removed. I’ll coordinate with privacy to scrub.
Aisha Ramos: OK — action summary: Tom pulls IAM inventory, Priya validates audit config + posts policy JSON, Nikita prepares sanitized logs and KMS ACL snapshot, I’ll freeze scope and lock retest slot. Will run a 30-min pre-retest dry run with SRE.
Tom Li: +1. Tagging @oncall and SRE for the dry run. :thumbsup:
Priya Nair: Uploading policy and snares to tracker now.
Nikita Patel: Scrubbed sample will be in tracker by EOD.
Aisha Ramos: Thanks team — if nothing else, we’ll call this frozen and start evidence capture at 6876543500.
